tools.name: salesplay_get_merchant
tools.description: Get the merchant account the access token belongs to. Good first call to confirm the connection. SalesPlay API: GET /merchant.

tools.name: salesplay_list_shops
tools.description: List the shops (outlets) of the merchant, with their details. SalesPlay API: GET /shops.

tools.name: salesplay_list_pos_devices
tools.description: List POS devices (tills) and the shop each one belongs to. SalesPlay API: GET /pos_devices.

tools.name: salesplay_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (staff accounts) of the merchant. SalesPlay API: GET /employee.

tools.name: salesplay_list_products
tools.description: List products with their codes, names, prices per shop, costs and stock settings. SalesPlay API: GET /products.

tools.name: salesplay_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories. SalesPlay API: GET /category.

tools.name: salesplay_list_sub_categories
tools.description: List product sub-categories and the category each belongs to. SalesPlay API: GET /sub_category.

tools.name: salesplay_list_measurements
tools.description: List measurement units used for products (for example pieces, kilograms). SalesPlay API: GET /measurements.

tools.name: salesplay_list_taxes
tools.description: List tax rules: names, rates, calculation methods and the shops they apply to. SalesPlay API: GET /taxes.

tools.name: salesplay_list_payment_types
tools.description: List payment types (for example cash or card) configured for the merchant. SalesPlay API: GET /payment_types.

tools.name: salesplay_list_order_types
tools.description: List order types (for example dine-in or takeaway). SalesPlay API: GET /order_types.

tools.name: salesplay_list_modifiers
tools.description: List product modifier groups and their modifiers. SalesPlay API: GET /modifiers.

tools.name: salesplay_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their contact details and tax numbers. SalesPlay API: GET /customers.

tools.name: salesplay_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their contact details. SalesPlay API: GET /suppliers.

tools.name: salesplay_list_receipts
tools.description: List sales receipts, optionally by receipt number or shop. SalesPlay API: GET /receipts.

tools.name: salesplay_list_void_receipts
tools.description: List voided receipts, optionally by receipt number or shop. SalesPlay API: GET /void_receipts.

tools.name: salesplay_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes and refunds, optionally by receipt number or shop. SalesPlay API: GET /credit_note_and_refund.

tools.name: salesplay_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, optionally by order number or shop. SalesPlay API: GET /orders.

tools.name: salesplay_list_online_order_status
tools.description: List the status of online orders received from sales channels, by system unique id. SalesPlay API: GET /online_order_status.

tools.name: salesplay_list_shifts
tools.description: List cash-desk shifts, optionally by shift id or POS device. SalesPlay API: GET /shifts.

tools.name: salesplay_list_inventory
tools.description: List stock levels per product in one or more shops. shop_ids is required. SalesPlay API: GET /inventory.

tools.name: salesplay_list_grn
tools.description: List goods received notes (GRNs): stock received from suppliers. SalesPlay API: GET /grn.

tools.name: salesplay_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders sent to suppliers. SalesPlay API: GET /purchase_orders.

tools.name: salesplay_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Only first_name is required. Creates a new record each call. SalesPlay API: POST /customers.

tools.name: salesplay_create_product
tools.description: Create a product with its cost and its price in each listed shop. Stock tracking and flags default to off. Creates a new product each call. SalesPlay API: POST /products.

tools.name: salesplay_update_inventory
tools.description: Set the stock quantity of products in shops. Each item sets the absolute in_stock value, so repeating the call gives the same result. SalesPlay API: POST /inventory.
